hardware_uart_control_workloads.description: Compile HC source (`5 + 7`) -> HASM -> HBC container -> execute on Tang Nano 20K HCPU silicon and return to loader.hasm
Execute single-cycle hardware HPACK (0x50), HCRC32 (0x51), and 6-Guard HGRD (0x43) + FRD on Jim (ROM[5]) on Tang Nano 20K silicon

Execute L_JIM (0xE4) + L_KHA (0xE6) 5-feature NUI L0 embedding (2,2,2,6,6) and Bab II BSM metric/14-DSP operations (HNRM2=112, HDIST=10, HDOT=9) + HGRD (FLAG_G=1) and return to loader.hasm so HDMI 1280x720 stays in STATE: RUNNING, GUARD: OK

RUNNING.panel_b_hybit_dsp: LETTER OP=0x00E6 (KHA), CODEX OP=0x0043 (HGRD), HNRM2=0x0070 (112), HDIST=0x000A (10), HDOT=0x0009 (9)
RUNNING.zone_6_nui_l0: TITIK=0x0002, GARIS=0x0002, LENGK=0x0002, THETA=0x0006, RHO=0x0006, EMBED=0x0008
RUNNING.zone_7a_buttons: STEV=0x0000 (or 0x0002 after resume), FLRC=0x0000 (or 0x002x after clean recovery)

STOPPED_VIA_S1_PIN88.trigger: Physical press on S1 (Pin 88, active-HIGH via 2-FF sync + 10.0 ms debounce)
STOPPED_VIA_S1_PIN88.panel_a_guard: OK (Green — pressing S1 never forces false GUARD: FAULT)
STOPPED_VIA_S1_PIN88.cpu_clock_gating: cpu_run_enable=0; PC, INSTRUCTION, CYCLE, and FLAGS freeze cleanly; HDMI 1280x720@60Hz stays locked

RECOVERY_VIA_S2_PIN87.trigger: Physical press on S2 (Pin 87, active-HIGH via 2-FF sync + 10.0 ms debounce)
RECOVERY_VIA_S2_PIN87.sequence: CTRL_RESETTING (16-cycle pulse on core_rst_trig) -> CTRL_READY (8 cycles) -> CTRL_RUNNING
RECOVERY_VIA_S2_PIN87.fault_rule: Clears fault_latched ONLY if fault source is no longer active; otherwise latches CTRL_FAULT_LATCHED (REC_FAIL_ACTIVE)
RECOVERY_VIA_S2_PIN87.zone_7a_buttons: STEV=0x0003 (or 0x0004 from fault), PRPO=0x0106 (STOPPED -> READY -> RUNNING)

UPDATE_BUTTON_BL616.role: Dedicated BL616 USB-JTAG debugger DFU firmware button near HDMI connector (not wired to FPGA GPIO)

physical_acceptance_status.note:
CT-NUI-CAS-V1.3 (`7fe32ef6...`) is verified on physical Tang Nano 20K + 1280x720@60Hz HDMI monitor: (1) JTAG & SRAM-only programming PASS (3.27 s), (2) HW-1 HC->HASM->HBC->HCPU UART execution PASS (`12

CYCLES=00606314

`, 22 bytes = `TX0X0016` on screen), (3) TV-safe overscan fixes (L0-L11 at col=4, CTRL FSM at col=32, BUILD:CT-NUI-CAS-V1.3 / BASE:920F3E61) PASS, (4) S1 STOP/RESUME (`RSDC000B` -> `STEV0101`/`PRP00001` STOPPED, `RSDC000C` -> `STEV0002`/`PRP00100` RUNNING) PASS, and (5) S2 RECOVERY (`RSDC0007`, `FLRC0027` -> 7 clean recoveries from HALTED to RUNNING) PASS. Trailing HALT in HW-1 has been replaced with `JMP 0` in `run_ct_nui_cas_v1_3_sram_load.py` so HW-2 and HW-3 can also stream back-to-back via `--uart-only` without halting.
